metadata.title: MedOrbits Admission Documents Database
metadata.description: Catalogue of document types that may be requested during admissions. Requirements for a specific admission must be checked against its official notification.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Entries describe commonly requested document types only. Do not present any document as mandatory for a specific admission until verified against the official notification.

dataRules: id and slug must be unique; slug must be lowercase kebab-case.
applicableAdmissionTypes must use values from allowedValues and match admissionType in the admissions data.
courseIds is optional; an empty list means the document is not limited to specific courses. Every value must reference an existing course.
originalRequired, attestationRequired, acceptedFormats, maxFileSizeKb and guidanceUrl must stay null or empty until taken from an official source.
A document being listed here does not mean it is required for any particular admission.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together.
verificationStatus 'verified' requires verifiedAt, verifiedBy and sourceUrl.
Never invent format, size, attestation or eligibility requirements.

documents.name: Entrance exam admit card
documents.description: Admit card or hall ticket issued for an entrance examination.

documents.name: Entrance exam scorecard or result
documents.description: Official scorecard, rank card or result issued by the examination authority.

documents.name: Exam application confirmation page
documents.description: Confirmation page or acknowledgement generated after submitting an examination application.

documents.name: Answer-key objection receipt
documents.description: Acknowledgement for an answer-key challenge, if the examination authority provides one.

documents.name: Exam application correction confirmation
documents.description: Confirmation of submitted corrections to an examination application, if applicable.

documents.name: Counselling registration confirmation
documents.description: Registration slip or confirmation issued by the counselling authority.

documents.name: Choice-filling confirmation
documents.description: Record of submitted course, college or institute preferences, where the portal provides one.

documents.name: Seat allotment letter
documents.description: Provisional or final seat allotment letter issued by the counselling authority.

documents.name: Counselling or seat acceptance fee receipt
documents.description: Receipt for counselling registration, security deposit or seat acceptance payment.

documents.name: Reporting or joining acknowledgement
documents.description: Acknowledgement issued by an institute or authority after reporting or joining.

documents.name: Class 10 marksheet and certificate
documents.description: Secondary-school marksheet and certificate; may be used to establish date of birth.

documents.name: Class 12 marksheet and passing certificate
documents.description: Higher-secondary marksheet and passing certificate showing subjects and marks.

documents.name: School leaving certificate
documents.description: Certificate issued by the school last attended, where relevant.

documents.name: Migration certificate
documents.description: Certificate issued by the previous board or institution, where relevant.

documents.name: Transfer certificate
documents.description: Transfer certificate issued by the previous institution, where relevant.

documents.name: Character certificate
documents.description: Character or conduct certificate from the previous institution, where relevant.

documents.name: Consolidated marksheet
documents.description: Consolidated marksheet covering completed semesters or years of a prior qualification.

documents.name: Degree or graduation certificate
documents.description: Award certificate for a completed diploma, undergraduate or postgraduate qualification.

documents.name: Provisional degree certificate
documents.description: Provisional evidence of degree completion, where the final certificate is not yet available and the institution accepts it.

documents.name: Academic transcripts
documents.description: Official academic transcript issued by the prior school, college or university.

documents.name: Backlog or arrears statement
documents.description: Statement of backlogs or arrears, if relevant to the institution's admission process.

documents.name: Government photo identification
documents.description: Government-issued photo identification; accepted identity documents depend on the authority.

documents.name: Passport
documents.description: Valid passport; commonly relevant to international applications and travel.

documents.name: Passport-size photograph
documents.description: Recent photograph meeting the relevant authority's image specification.

documents.name: Scanned signature
documents.description: Signature image meeting the relevant portal's specification.

documents.name: Address proof
documents.description: Document establishing current or permanent address, where requested.

documents.name: Domicile or residence certificate
documents.description: Certificate of domicile or residence, where a state or regional eligibility rule applies.

documents.name: Caste or category certificate
documents.description: Certificate supporting a reserved-category claim, in the format prescribed by the relevant authority.

documents.name: Economically Weaker Section certificate
documents.description: EWS certificate, where applicable and in the format and validity period prescribed by the authority.

documents.name: Disability certificate
documents.description: Disability certificate or assessment document, where relevant to an accommodation or reservation claim.

documents.name: NRI or sponsor documents
documents.description: Documents supporting an NRI, sponsored or similar quota claim, where applicable.

documents.name: Qualification equivalence certificate
documents.description: Equivalence certificate for a qualification obtained under a different board, system or country, where requested.

documents.name: Credit transfer or course equivalency documents
documents.description: Syllabi, course descriptions or credit records used to assess transfer or equivalency, where applicable.

documents.name: Medical fitness certificate
documents.description: Fitness certificate from a qualified medical practitioner, where required by the admission authority.

documents.name: Immunization or vaccination record
documents.description: Immunization record, if requested by the institution or placement setting.

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.description: Income proof used for a fee concession, scholarship or financial-aid assessment, where applicable.

documents.name: Bank account proof
documents.description: Bank account details for refunds or scholarship payments, where requested; avoid sharing credentials or PINs.

documents.name: Application or admission fee receipt
documents.description: Receipt confirming an application, tuition or admission-related payment.

documents.name: Scholarship or financial-aid application
documents.description: Application and supporting papers for a scholarship or financial-aid scheme.

documents.name: Education loan sanction letter
documents.description: Lender's sanction letter, if used to document funding arrangements.

documents.name: Statement of purpose
documents.description: Applicant statement describing academic goals and reasons for applying, where requested.

documents.name: Letters of recommendation
documents.description: Recommendations from referees in the form and quantity requested by the institution.

documents.name: Resume or curriculum vitae
documents.description: Summary of education, experience, projects and relevant achievements, where requested.

documents.name: Portfolio or work samples
documents.description: Portfolio of creative, design, research or other relevant work, where required.

documents.name: English proficiency test result
documents.description: Language-proficiency result, where required by the institution or destination country.

documents.name: Other language proficiency result
documents.description: Language test result for the language of instruction, where requested.

documents.name: Research proposal
documents.description: Proposed research topic, objectives and methodology for research-degree applications, where requested.

documents.name: Writing sample
documents.description: Academic or professional writing sample, where requested.

documents.name: Work experience certificate
documents.description: Employer-issued proof of work experience, where relevant to eligibility or selection.

documents.name: Interview or entrance-test call letter
documents.description: Call letter or schedule issued for an interview, aptitude test or other selection stage.

documents.name: Student visa or residence-permit documents
documents.description: Visa or residence-permit paperwork for international study; exact requirements depend on the destination authority.

documents.name: Regulatory eligibility or recognition certificate
documents.description: Eligibility, recognition or clearance document from a relevant regulator, where specifically required.

documents.name: Professional registration certificate
documents.description: Registration or licence from a professional body, where relevant to the course or admission route.

documents.name: Undertaking or affidavit
documents.description: Declaration or affidavit in the exact form prescribed by the institution or authority, where requested.

documents.name: Gap-year affidavit or certificate
documents.description: Document explaining a study gap, if the institution or authority requests one.

documents.name: Parent or guardian consent
documents.description: Consent form for applicants for whom guardian consent is required by the relevant process.

documents.name: Name change or name discrepancy proof
documents.description: Legal document connecting different names across academic, identity or application records.

documents.name: Lost-document or duplicate-certificate declaration
documents.description: Declaration or supporting report for a lost document, where an authority permits an alternative.

documents.name: Accessibility or examination accommodation request
documents.description: Request and supporting documentation for an accommodation, following the relevant authority's procedure.

documents.name: International credential evaluation report
documents.description: Evaluation report issued by an accepted credential-evaluation service, where requested.

documents.name: Parent or sponsor financial-support declaration
documents.description: Declaration supporting a funding arrangement, where requested by an institution or visa authority.

documents.name: Police clearance certificate
documents.description: Police clearance document, only where explicitly required by the relevant institution or authority.

documents.name: Marriage certificate for name discrepancy
documents.description: Marriage certificate, where relevant to explaining a name change across records.

documents.name: Nationality or citizenship proof
documents.description: Proof of nationality or citizenship, where the authority needs to establish applicant status.

documents.name: Residence permit
documents.description: Current residence permit or similar document, where relevant to an international application.

documents.name: Non-creamy layer certificate
documents.description: Non-creamy layer certificate, where applicable to a category claim and subject to the authority's rules.

documents.name: Special-area or tribal-area certificate
documents.description: Certificate for a special regional eligibility category, only where recognized by the relevant admission rules.

documents.name: Special migrant-category certificate
documents.description: Certificate supporting a special migrant-category claim, where an official admission policy recognizes it.

documents.name: Defence or service-category certificate
documents.description: Service or dependent certificate for a special category, where the relevant admission policy provides for it.

documents.name: Sports achievement certificate
documents.description: Sports achievement or participation evidence, where a sports quota or assessment is available.

documents.name: Relevant experience certificate
documents.description: Evidence of relevant work, clinical, teaching or professional experience, where it is an eligibility criterion.

documents.name: Professional council registration proof
documents.description: Evidence of current professional registration, where required for a course or advanced entry route.

documents.name: Blood group record
documents.description: Blood group information or test record, only if specifically requested by the institution.

documents.name: Disability assessment report
documents.description: Assessment report from an authorized centre, where the admission authority's process requires it.

documents.name: Health insurance proof
documents.description: Evidence of health insurance, where required by an institution or destination-country process.

documents.name: Financial sponsorship letter
documents.description: Letter from a sponsor describing financial support, where required for admission or visa assessment.

documents.name: Bank statement
documents.description: Bank-issued statement used as financial evidence, where requested; redact unrelated sensitive details when permitted.

documents.name: Proof of available funds
documents.description: Evidence of funds for tuition or living costs, where required by the institution or immigration authority.

documents.name: Scholarship award letter
documents.description: Official letter confirming a scholarship or funding award, if the applicant has one.

documents.name: Fee waiver approval
documents.description: Confirmation of an application-fee or tuition-fee waiver, where applicable.

documents.name: Personal statement
documents.description: Applicant statement requested by an institution; follow the institution's current instructions.

documents.name: Audition recording or audition materials
documents.description: Recording or materials for an audition-based course, where required.

documents.name: Written test or assessment submission
documents.description: Written assessment or other selection-stage submission, where requested.

documents.name: Employer reference
documents.description: Reference from an employer or supervisor, where requested.

documents.name: Publications or research outputs list
documents.description: List of publications, posters, presentations or other research outputs, where relevant.

documents.name: Professional licence or registration evidence
documents.description: Professional licence evidence where it is relevant to admission or prior experience.

documents.name: Language-of-instruction proof
documents.description: Official evidence of prior study in a specified language, if an institution accepts it for language requirements.

documents.name: Credential evaluation report
documents.description: Evaluation of foreign academic credentials by a service accepted by the receiving institution, where requested.

documents.name: Submitted application copy
documents.description: Copy or PDF of the submitted application for the applicant's records, if the portal provides one.

documents.name: Admission offer letter
documents.description: Conditional or unconditional offer issued by an institution.

documents.name: Offer acceptance confirmation
documents.description: Confirmation that an applicant accepted an offer, where the institution's portal provides one.

documents.name: Enrollment confirmation
documents.description: Institution-issued confirmation of enrollment or registration after admission.

documents.name: Prior visa refusal explanation or record
documents.description: Previous visa refusal records or explanation, only if explicitly requested by the relevant authority.

documents.name: Certificate of good standing
documents.description: Good-standing certificate from a professional regulator, where required for the programme or applicant category.

documents.name: Internship completion certificate
documents.description: Evidence of completed internship or supervised practice, where relevant to entry requirements.

documents.name: Regulatory eligibility letter
documents.description: Eligibility letter issued by a competent regulator, only where the applicable process requires it.

documents.name: Parent or guardian consent form
documents.description: Consent form for applicants who require guardian consent under the applicable process.

documents.name: Study gap explanation letter
documents.description: Applicant explanation of a study gap, if requested; a notarized affidavit should not be assumed necessary.

documents.name: Declaration of document authenticity
documents.description: Declaration that submitted documents are genuine, where the authority requests it.

documents.name: Certified translation declaration
documents.description: Certification associated with a translation, where the receiving authority requires a certified translation.

documents.name: Admission document checklist
documents.description: Checklist supplied by the institution or counselling authority for a particular admission cycle.

documents.name: Document dispatch or courier proof
documents.description: Tracking receipt or dispatch acknowledgement if physical documents are sent and the institution requests them.

documents.name: Document upload acknowledgement
documents.description: Portal-generated acknowledgement showing that files were uploaded, where available.

documents.name: Interview attendance acknowledgement
documents.description: Attendance confirmation for an interview or selection event, if issued.

documents.name: Parent or guardian relationship proof
documents.description: Civil or legal record establishing a parent or guardian relationship, where specifically requested.

documents.name: Deferred admission approval
documents.description: Written approval confirming a deferral to a later intake, if granted.

documents.name: Prior admission cancellation or withdrawal proof
documents.description: Evidence of cancellation or withdrawal from a previous admission, if the new process requests it.

documents.name: Original document deposit receipt
documents.description: Receipt issued when original documents are deposited with an institution, where that process is used.

documents.name: Hostel or accommodation application
documents.description: Application for campus housing or accommodation, separate from academic admission where applicable.

documents.name: Anti-ragging undertaking
documents.description: Undertaking requested under the institution's applicable student-safety process; verify the current official instructions.

documents.name: Student conduct declaration
documents.description: Institutional conduct or code-of-conduct declaration, where requested.

documents.name: Guardian income proof
documents.description: Income evidence for a parent or guardian, where required for financial aid or sponsorship.
